versions.changelog:
feishu-easy-at 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides clear guidance on how to correctly @ mention users in Feishu messages.
- Explains why directly typing @xxx does not trigger mention notifications.
- Recommends using "post" rich text messages with "at" tags for proper mentions.
- Describes methods to obtain user_id or open_id needed for accurate @ targeting.
- Includes ready-to-use JSON examples for constructing mention messages.
